policy_sources.checked: Operating Agreement, 'Updated: October 15, 2025'. Section 5 'Identifying Yourself as an Associate' requires: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.” - rule R-01 confirmed verbatim.

Associates Program Policies, 'Updated: April 14, 2026'. Commission Income Statement Section 1 (Qualifying Purchases / Qualifying Revenue) read. Participation Requirements 2(a)-(b) (Special Links, tag parameter, price display limited to Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API, price-comparison rule), 3(f) (paid search on Amazon marks), 3(g) (marks in domains/tags), 3(p) (links in Amazon content), 3(s) (artificially generated clicks), 3(t) (customer reviews / star ratings only via Creators API / PA API), 3(w) (link shortening clarity), 4-6 and the IP License (no data mining or robots; no Special Links/Program Content for machine-learning development without prior written approval) read. - rules R-02 to R-10, R-14, R-15 confirmed; supports F-17.

Associates Central help 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?': link-level disclosure must be clear and conspicuous and placed near any affiliate link; the Operating Agreement statement must clearly and conspicuously appear on the Site. - rule R-16 confirmed.

The commission schedule URL redirects to an Amazon sign-in page (openid return_to=/home/account/payment/customratecard). No category commission rate could be read from an official source. - F-01 confirmed; rate remains blank.

Amazon Conditions of Use, 'Last updated: August 14, 2026'. 'License and Access' excludes collection and use of product listings, descriptions or prices, and data mining / robots; and bars use of AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. - F-11 and F-12 confirmed.

FTC 'Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers' (November 2019): disclosure must be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement, in simple and clear language; a material connection includes a financial relationship. - rule R-13 confirmed.
